Key.Original: Log cartography diagnostics to the RPT. Turn this on before reporting a fault.
Key.English: Log cartography diagnostics to the RPT. Turn this on before reporting a fault.

Key.Original: Cartography Debug Log
Key.English: Cartography Debug Log

Key.Original: Draw a coloured Koppen biome cell per sample over the visible map, from the aee per-position biome kernel. The cells are the mod's own computed biome at each cell centre. Default on; the layer draws only when the physics overlay master switch is on.
Key.English: Draw a coloured Koppen biome cell per sample over the visible map, from the aee per-position biome kernel. The cells are the mod's own computed biome at each cell centre. Default on; the layer draws only when the physics overlay master switch is on.

Key.Original: Map Biome Layer
Key.English: Map Biome Layer

Key.Original: Click the map to read the aee state at that point: the per-position biome, surface material, local wind and terrain height, plus the current global temperature, WBGT, flood, fire, snow, radio and hypoxia values. The readout uses the mod weather-report style. Default on; the query runs only when the physics overlay master switch is on.
Key.English: Click the map to read the aee state at that point: the per-position biome, surface material, local wind and terrain height, plus the current global temperature, WBGT, flood, fire, snow, radio and hypoxia values. The readout uses the mod weather-report style. Default on; the query runs only when the physics overlay master switch is on.

Key.Original: Map Click Query
Key.English: Map Click Query

Key.Original: Draw a magnetic-declination rose on the map: the true-north ray (the map up axis) and the magnetic-north ray the compass deviation model computes. The rose reads the aee magnetic declination the compass uses. Default on; the rose draws only when the physics overlay master switch is on.
Key.English: Draw a magnetic-declination rose on the map: the true-north ray (the map up axis) and the magnetic-north ray the compass deviation model computes. The rose reads the aee magnetic declination the compass uses. Default on; the rose draws only when the physics overlay master switch is on.

Key.Original: Map Declination Rose
Key.English: Map Declination Rose

Key.Original: Master switch for the physics-state tactical map overlay. On: the per-position biome and wind layers, the declination rose and the click query draw on the open map. Off: the map is unchanged. Default off.
Key.English: Master switch for the physics-state tactical map overlay. On: the per-position biome and wind layers, the declination rose and the click query draw on the open map. Off: the map is unchanged. Default off.

Key.Original: Map Physics Overlay
Key.English: Map Physics Overlay

Key.Original: Draw a local-wind arrow per sample over the visible map, from the aee per-position local wind field. The arrow points the way the wind blows toward. The field is sampled at most once a second, so the map stays smooth. Default on; the layer draws only when the physics overlay master switch is on.
Key.English: Draw a local-wind arrow per sample over the visible map, from the aee per-position local wind field. The arrow points the way the wind blows toward. The field is sampled at most once a second, so the map stays smooth. Default on; the layer draws only when the physics overlay master switch is on.

Key.Original: Map Wind Layer
Key.English: Map Wind Layer

Key.Original: Show the aee MGRS reference and the terrain elevation at the map cursor. The vanilla cursor tooltip is engine-side and cannot be replaced, so the aee readout is drawn adjacent to it. Default on.
Key.English: Show the aee MGRS reference and the terrain elevation at the map cursor. The vanilla cursor tooltip is engine-side and cannot be replaced, so the aee readout is drawn adjacent to it. Default on.

Key.Original: MGRS Cursor Readout
Key.English: MGRS Cursor Readout

Key.Original: Show the grid line as a full MGRS reference (zone, latitude band, 100 km square and digits) from the aee world-to-MGRS kernel instead of the engine numeric grid. Off restores the legacy numeric grid. Default on.
Key.English: Show the grid line as a full MGRS reference (zone, latitude band, 100 km square and digits) from the aee world-to-MGRS kernel instead of the engine numeric grid. Off restores the legacy numeric grid. Default on.

Key.Original: MGRS Grid
Key.English: MGRS Grid

Key.Original: Draw the aee MGRS grid over the engine map: the grid lines and their MGRS labels at an interval that follows the zoom. The engine grid stays numeric because the CfgWorlds Grid class formats numbers only, so the aee overlay draws the MGRS lines over it. Default on.
Key.English: Draw the aee MGRS grid over the engine map: the grid lines and their MGRS labels at an interval that follows the zoom. The engine grid stays numeric because the CfgWorlds Grid class formats numbers only, so the aee overlay draws the MGRS lines over it. Default on.

Key.Original: MGRS Map Grid
Key.English: MGRS Map Grid

Key.Original: Scale the MGRS digit count with the world map size. On: a small world gets a six-figure reference (100 m) and a large world an eight-figure one (10 m). Off: the MGRS Precision list applies. Default on.
Key.English: Scale the MGRS digit count with the world map size. On: a small world gets a six-figure reference (100 m) and a large world an eight-figure one (10 m). Off: the MGRS Precision list applies. Default on.

Key.Original: MGRS Precision Auto
Key.English: MGRS Precision Auto

Key.Original: Number of MGRS digits, one of 4, 6, 8 or 10. Four digits is 1 km, six is 100 m, eight is 10 m and ten is 1 m. The digits label the south-west corner of the square and are truncated, not rounded. Default 10.
Key.English: Number of MGRS digits, one of 4, 6, 8 or 10. Four digits is 1 km, six is 100 m, eight is 10 m and ten is 1 m. The digits label the south-west corner of the square and are truncated, not rounded. Default 10.

Key.Original: MGRS Precision
Key.English: MGRS Precision
